sources.title: Independent log-softmax gradient derivation
sources.details: For fixed A=r-b and p_i=exp(z_i)/sum(exp(z)), loss=-A log(p_a); dL/dz_i=A(p_i-delta_ia). At z=[0,0], A=.5,a=1 gives [.25,-.25]; z_new=z-.1*grad and p_1=1/(1+exp(-.05))=.5124973964842103. A=-.5 reverses signs; A=0 gives no change. verify.py independently checks analytic and centered finite differences.

sources.title: Actual original fence and bounded CPU verification

claims.statement: Policy is an action probability distribution; the one-step reward-minus-baseline estimate weights negative selected-action log probability. Positive/negative fixed advantage changes the selected-action direction correspondingly.
claims.scope: Single fixed-action demonstration and on-policy score-function estimator. General neural-network/AdamW updates are not asserted to monotonically improve every action probability.

evidence.supports: Score-function loss and negative sign for descent; sampled actions in formal algorithm.
Action-independent reference baseline; sampled return-minus-baseline weights and advantage interpretation.
Exact conditional sign for direct score update.

claims.statement: With answer order 3/4, action=1, reward=1, baseline=.5 and step=.1, gradient is [.25,-.25], scores become approximately [-.025,.025] and probabilities round to [.487503,.512497]. Reward=0 reverses the direction.
claims.location: C.7 Python fence, result paragraph, figure, exercise
claims.scope: Two direct scores, one arithmetic gradient step. No LM training and no sampling in this primary example.

evidence.locator: Exact formula and exp(.05) logistic evaluation
evidence.supports: Independently recomputed gradients, score movement and both rewards.
Axis 0 over two scores and normalized/log probability definitions.

verification.observed: Original float32 prints expected six decimals; independent float64 matches exact analytic formula; changed action and zero-advantage variants also pass.
verification.details: Original fence exit 0. Centered finite differences use epsilon 1e-6 and gradient error <1e-10. Figure numbers agree.
verification.tolerance: Float64 analytic gradients absolute 1e-14; finite difference absolute 1e-10; probabilities round exactly to six displayed decimals; original float32 score difference <1e-8.

claims.statement: requires_grad/backward records gradients, detach permits old-value comparison, and no_grad computes new scores without recording the update graph. The original logits are not changed in-place; updated is a newly computed tensor.
claims.location: C.7 Python fence and following explanatory paragraph
claims.scope: Grouped ordinary PyTorch API coverage; reward and baseline are Python constants, so no verifier gradient exists.

evidence.supports: Leaf gradients accumulate; detach disconnects graph but shares storage.
Disables gradient tracking of update arithmetic.

evidence.locator: original fence and verify.py sign variants
evidence.supports: Actual arithmetic executes and after probabilities differ while old logits stay zero.

verification.expected: Original logits stay [0,0], .grad is populated, updated.requires_grad=False, before remains [.5,.5], and after reflects update.
verification.observed: Original fence and four bounded analytic/API variants pass; no_grad update produces changed scores and normalized probabilities.
verification.details: No optimizer is implied in the primary example; it directly constructs updated scores.

claims.statement: The separate finite policy takes three six-way one-hot operands (18 features), maps through 18→48 tanh→17 logits, and maps IDs 0–15 to single integers and ID 16 to enumeration. Strict and weak reward rules operate on these mapped strings.
claims.scope: Predefined 17-action policy; zero autoregressive tokens. Not TinyLM generation.

evidence.supports: Exact feature, architecture, action and reward contracts.

evidence.locator: verify.py features, action mapping and raw sample loops
evidence.supports: Checks shape, three active cells, every raw ID/string/reward pair and all truth values.

verification.expected: 18 features with 3 active cells, 17 logits; enumeration proxy=1 and strict=0 for all truth values in 0–15.
verification.observed: Bounded shape checks [2,18]→[2,17] pass; all original sampled IDs and both rewards match independently reconstructed strings and criteria.
verification.details: No LM is instantiated by the verification; raw recorded finite-policy results are recomputed.

claims.statement: Formal finite-policy training samples Categorical actions, weights log probabilities by relative rewards, and updates score-producing parameters through AdamW.
claims.scope: Actual original implementation has EMA baseline, entropy bonus .005 and gradient clipping; the simple two-score example illustrates the central score-function term only.
